blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Senate ratified on Tuesday the bicameral conference committee report on establishing the National Specialty Center for Geriatric Health. Sponsored in the upper chamber by Sen. Risa Hontiveros, the committee report reconciles provisions of Senate Bill No. 1509 and the House Bill No. 6739 or the Philippine Geriatric Center (PGC) Act for older adults. “Under the reconciled measure, the National Specialty Center for Geriatric Health, to be known as the Philippine Geriatric Center, under the direct control and supervision of the Department of Health, will eventually serve as the national apex and coordinating center for geriatric health services,” Hontiveros […]...
